economy.summary: In a 2024 candidate survey, said Pennsylvania cannot rely on natural gas as the sole source for its energy because it is too expensive, and supports diversifying the state's energy grid to lower energy costs.
economy.short: Supports diversifying energy sources to lower energy costs.

abortion.summary: In a 2024 candidate survey, said he has voted to support several efforts to expand protections for women seeking abortion, and cited his endorsement by Planned Parenthood.
abortion.short: Supports expanding abortion access; voted for abortion protections.

education.summary: In a 2024 candidate survey, said the funding of charter schools and the expansion of EITC tax-credit scholarship funding at such levels must end.
education.short: Opposes current levels of charter school and EITC funding.

energy.summary: Co-prime sponsored House Bill 2017, which would direct the Environmental Quality Board to set separate fees for small modular and micro nuclear reactor sites to make their construction more affordable; he said the bill levels the playing field for nuclear innovation and helps diversify the grid. The bill passed both chambers in July 2026.
energy.short: Co-prime sponsored bill easing state fees for small nuclear reactors.

guns.summary: In a 2023 interview, described himself as a gun owner who opposes permitless carry and said he wants to see sensible gun reforms including expanded background checks.
guns.short: Gun owner; opposes permitless carry, supports expanded background checks.
